bug_summary: famfs_mknod() pins dentries using bare dget() without setting DCACHE_PERSISTENT. The VFS unmount path (select_collect_umount) only releases dentry pins for entries marked DCACHE_PERSISTENT, so every famfs file dentry retains refcount=1 at umount_check time, triggering 'BUG: Dentry still in use' warnings. Fix: replace d_instantiate()+dget() with d_make_persistent(), which sets DCACHE_PERSISTENT and bumps the refcount atomically.

root_cause.description: famfs_mknod() at fs/famfs/famfs_inode.c calls d_instantiate(dentry, inode) followed by dget(dentry) to pin the dentry in the dcache. However, the VFS unmount helper select_collect_umount() (fs/dcache.c:1548) only drops the extra pin for dentries that have DCACHE_PERSISTENT set in d_flags. Since the bare dget() call does not set DCACHE_PERSISTENT, the pin is invisible to the unmount path and is never released. The correct API is d_make_persistent() which sets DCACHE_PERSISTENT and bumps the refcount atomically. A secondary bug also exists: famfs_kill_sb frees sb->s_fs_info before calling kill_char_super(), which runs evict_inodes() and show_options() callbacks that may access s_fs_info.

evidence.detail: fs/dcache.c:2796-2811 — sets DCACHE_PERSISTENT flag and calls dget_dlock() atomically

fix_suggestion: PRIMARY: In famfs_mknod(), replace 'd_instantiate(dentry, inode); dget(dentry);' with 'd_make_persistent(dentry, inode);'. SECONDARY: In famfs_kill_sb(), move kill_char_super(sb) to BEFORE the kfree(fsi)/s_fs_info=NULL cleanup, so that evict_inodes() and other super callbacks can still access s_fs_info during teardown.
